translations.web: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
translations.bsb: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have seized you.
translations.kjv: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold
translations.asv: But thou art full of the judgment of the wicked: Judgment and justice take hold on thee.
